deviations.what: build.sh: dropped the trailing fuzz-targets build
deviations.why: it hardcodes ./configure CC="clang", which overrides compile_afl's afl-clang-fast and yields an UNINSTRUMENTED library
deviations.rationale: that step builds only the pem_cert target; fuzzer-wolfssl-rsa comes from the nested wolf-ssl-ssh-fuzzers build, which respects $CC and $LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE

deviations.what: build.sh: removed --enable-blake2 --enable-blake2s from the nested configure params
deviations.why: clang 18 rejects wolfcrypt/blake2-int.h with a hard error on array element alignment that clang 12 accepted
deviations.rationale: blake2 is independent of RSA and our target is fuzzer-wolfssl-rsa; however feature flags change binary/heap layout and this is a heap-buffer-overflow, so the PoC verification is the empirical check
